conversation_brief.heading: Discussing current conditions
conversation_brief.context: Economic and infrastructure performance can affect sectors differently.
conversation_brief.starter: How are current operating conditions affecting businesses in your sector?
conversation_brief.avoid: That every business or region is experiencing the same conditions.

conversation_brief.heading: Approaching political developments
conversation_brief.context: Political subjects may be strongly felt and should not be approached through assumptions.
conversation_brief.starter: There seem to have been several important political developments recently. How are they being viewed in your industry?
conversation_brief.avoid: A person’s political affiliation or position on a controversial issue.

conversation_brief.heading: Discussing practical disruption
conversation_brief.context: Service disruption can be addressed through its effect on business rather than blame.
conversation_brief.starter: Have recent infrastructure conditions changed how your organisation plans its day-to-day operations?
conversation_brief.avoid: That the person assigns responsibility to a particular party or institution.
